title: State Cyber Cell - Emergency Incident Review (Case FIR-2026-9941)
agenda: Review of Phishing SIM-Swapping Attack under Case FIR-2026-9941
Analysis of Compromised Financial Accounts and Ticket CY-2026-8812
Immediate Action Plan for Account Freezing and ISP Log Subpoena
decisions: Freeze beneficiary accounts at State Bank immediately under section 91 CrPC
Issue urgent notice to Telecom Provider for CDR and IP logs related to Ticket CY-2026-8812
Escalate case status to High Priority Cyber Financial Fraud

action_items.task: Issue formal 91 CrPC notice to bank nodal officer for freezing accounts
Extract memory dump and packet capture logs from compromised terminal
Submit daily progress summary to Cyber Cell Superintendent
